title: Zesty Tender Venezuelan Chicken Skillet
description: A savory and tender weeknight Venezuelan dish featuring a blend of Mediterranean flavors, vanilla sugar, and coconut cream, perfect for a quick dinner. This recipe combines the richness of coconut with the brightness of citrus and spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the vanilla sugar, garlic powder, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for 1 minute, until the spices are fragrant.
Stir in the coconut cream and lime juice.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened, about 10 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the chicken and sauce hot over rice or with roasted vegetables.
